column1: # Where each woven Portuguese verb form in lex-pt.tsv was read.
# A verb row weaves its second form under an English -ing, and the tooltip
# prints that form as the word the reader met. Portuguese weaves the
# gerund, the gerúndio of "estou dizendo", not a present participle: the
# seed's header said "present participle" for every language until
# 2026-10-08. That day every woven Portuguese form was read in the
# "Gerund" row of the conjugation table on English Wiktionary's Portuguese
# entry for its verb, rendered as a reader sees it, because a verb's
# headword line prints none of its gerunds. All 80 are the form their
# verb's table prints, and none was changed.
# quote is the row's label and its cell, as printed, the label capitalised
# as the Portuguese table prints it.
# Whether that form answers to every English -ing it is woven under — the
# progressive's participle, or a gerund used as a noun, "reading is fun" —
# is a call about the language rather than a lookup, written up in TODO.md
# tests/tools/verb-forms.test.ts requires every verb lex-pt.tsv weaves in
# a second form to have a line here with that form, citing the verb's own
# entry, its quote printing the form in the "Gerund" cell, and fails on a
